# YT Labels

> Factory-direct custom labels for cosmetic, skincare, personal care, wash-care, candle and fragrance packaging. B2B quotes, minimums, proofs and schedules are confirmed per project.

YT Labels (https://www.ytlabels.com/) manufactures custom printed packaging labels for business buyers. This file summarizes copy already published on the site. It is not a quotation, a test report or a certification. Formulation, filling and approval of product claims stay with the brand and its manufacturing partners.

Do not infer a factory street address, a certification, a telephone number or a social profile that is not written on the cited page. Quote requests use the email address and WhatsApp path published on the contact page.

## What YT Labels supplies

- Custom labels for cosmetic and skincare packaging, including bottles, jars, tubes and multi-SKU sets.
- Custom labels for personal care and wash-care packaging, including shampoo, body wash, hand soap, laundry and home-care packs.
- Custom labels for candle and fragrance packaging, including jars, lids, tins and gift boxes.
- Roll or sheet supply. Material and finish options discussed on the site include clear PET, waterproof BOPP, vinyl, textured paper, matte or gloss laminate, and foil details where the artwork and quantity support them.
- Sizes, materials, finishes, minimum order quantities, prices and production timing depend on the approved construction, the number of designs and the application method. No single minimum or fixed price applies to every job.

## Quotes, MOQ and proof

- A usable quote needs the container (photo or sample, material and coating), label width and height with units, quantity for each artwork version, number of designs, finish preference, hand or machine application, roll or sheet format, artwork status and destination country. Name any detail that is still unknown and ask for a written project-specific proposal.
- Preferred artwork files are AI, PDF, PSD, EPS, SVG or high-resolution PNG. Reference images can be sent before final artwork.
- Low MOQ can be reviewed for many cosmetic, wash-care and candle projects. The minimum depends on size, material and finish. An example such as 3 designs × 500 labels = 1,500 labels describes an order. It is not a published minimum or price tier.
- YT Labels can prepare a digital proof or mockup for review before production. Product pages describe that proof as free. A digital proof reviews text, layout, dimensions and artwork placement. It does not by itself confirm adhesion, wet-use durability, exact physical colour or machine application.
- Physical samples may be arranged after artwork, material, size and proof details are confirmed. Sample cost and timing depend on material, finish and order requirements. Bulk production starts after final artwork, material and order details are approved.
- A requested in-hand date is a planning input until it is confirmed. Finished label orders can be shipped worldwide. Delivery time depends on destination, order size and shipping method.

## How to read the guides

- Buying guides explain a decision and the specifications still missing. They do not establish that a particular adhesive works on a bottle, that a file is print-ready, or that a trading partner accepts a code.
- Images described as AI-generated packaging examples are illustrations. They are not evidence of a customer order, a factory process, a certification or a measured test result.
- Order terms are project-specific. Confirm material, quantity per design, finish, sampling, price, production and delivery in the written proposal.
